item.title: BIOBUZZ Season Kickoff
item.description: The 2026–27 FIRST Tech Challenge season is here. This year's game is BIOBUZZ presented by RTX, part of the FIRST CANOPY biodiversity season.

item.title: Recruiting New Members for 2026–27
item.description: Interested in robotics, engineering, or software? We're looking for motivated students to join the team this season. No experience needed.
